prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 9:16 low-fi Y2K bedroom portrait of a 21-year-old adult woman at 4 AM. She has disheveled long hair, soft messy mascara, a distant thoughtful gaze, natural dewy skin, a white ribbed long-sleeve crew-neck top, relaxed charcoal lounge shorts, layered unbranded silver necklaces, and wired earphones loosely around her neck. Pose her lying comfortably on a floor of abstract paper textures and cables, looking upward to a high-angle camera. Surround her with red LED strips, blurred vinyl stacks, tangled white cables, and an old TV showing abstract static with no text. Use deep red LED and cold blue phone light, saturated dual-tone contrast, heavy shadows, soft bloom, slightly soft focus, vintage digital grain, and no readable text or logos.
